institution: The Chinese University of Hong Kong

app_fee.value: Non-refundable, non-transferable application fee of HK$500 per programme.
app_fee.quote: The application fee is HK$500 per programme (except for MBA, MBA in Finance and MSc in Finance).

also.quote: All fees, once paid, are non-refundable and non-transferable under any circumstances.

fee_waiver.value: CUHK Graduate School fees page lists the HK$500 non-refundable application fee and does not state an application fee waiver policy.

gre_general.value: CUHK Graduate School general admissions requirements do not state a university-wide GRE General requirement for PhD programmes (individual Graduate Divisions may recommend or require GRE; see ECE).

toefl_min.value: Minimum TOEFL iBT score is 4.5 of 6 on the new scale (or 79 of 120 on the 0-120 scale; Home Edition accepted; single-attempt scores only, MyBest Scores not accepted).

also.quote: No, we only accept the test result from each individual attempt.

ielts_min.value: Minimum IELTS Academic score is 6.5 (Test Centre based or Online; single-attempt scores only, One Skill Retake not accepted).

english_waiver.value: English proficiency test is waived for applicants who obtained a degree from a university in Hong Kong or completed a degree programme whose medium of instruction was English (requires certifying letter from the university Registry).
english_waiver.quote: obtained a Degree from a university in Hong Kong1 or taken a degree programme of which the medium of instruction was English;

also.quote: A certifying letter issued by the Registry of the university confirming the medium of instruction of your degree programme was English

notes: CUHK offers articulated MPhil-PhD programmes across 16 covered STEM fields (no Civil Engineering or Chemical Engineering PhD is offered; Faculty of Engineering consists of 6 departments: Biomedical Engineering, Computer Science & Engineering, Electronic Engineering, Information Engineering, Mechanical & Automation Engineering, and Systems Engineering & Engineering Management). General Regulations allow individual Graduate Divisions to set additional test requirements (Electronic Engineering highly recommends GRE General for non-Hong Kong graduates). Application fee is HK$500 per programme (non-refundable); TOEFL MyBest Scores and IELTS One Skill Retake are not accepted. Tuition is HK$49,500/yr for 2027-28 (waived for eligible local full-time research postgraduate students and HKPFS awardees); standard Postgraduate Studentship is HK$229,200/yr (~HK$19,100/mo) in 2026-27, rising to HK$28,700/mo under HKPFS.
